summary: Asphalt entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Asphalt 8: Airborne
entries.definitive_edition: Current official app build, with platform/version and economy state documented

emulation.notes: Use native mobile/Windows app route where available.

primary.why: Asphalt 8 is a long-running free-to-play arcade racer whose available content, economy, car roster, and events have changed heavily through updates. The current official app route is the practical archive target, while the 2013 launch balance is a historical state that cannot be cleanly reconstructed through normal storefront access.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official app build on a capture-friendly platform. Record platform, app version, account state, online/offline availability, car roster/progression, event availability, IAP state, and controller or touch controls.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the Apple Arcade economy/content variant.
secondary.why: Airborne+ is a distinct access and economy route, not the same live-service state as the free app.

all_releases.fidelity: Original mobile launch family and ongoing live-service route.
all_releases.reason: primary: core platform identity and current official app access.

all_releases.platform: Windows / Windows Phone / other mobile platforms
all_releases.fidelity: Alternate official app routes with platform-specific controls and availability.
all_releases.reason: primary if PC-style capture is available, but record platform and version.

all_releases.fidelity: Premium Apple Arcade variant with different economy/access assumptions.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Current content completeness conflicts with launch-era balance and retired events/cars.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record live-service version, account/progression state, event availability, and any IAP or subscription effects.

entries.title: Asphalt Legends
entries.definitive_edition: Current Asphalt Legends Unite client with platform/account/event state documented

emulation.notes: Use official live client; service state controls access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official client with exact platform/account/version state documented

primary.version: Current Asphalt Legends Unite live client
primary.why: Asphalt 9: Legends was rebranded/expanded into Asphalt Legends Unite, so the current live client is the practical route. This is a live-service racer; car roster, events, economy, platform cross-play, and account state must be captured at play time.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official Asphalt Legends Unite client on a capture-friendly platform. Record platform, app/client version, account, garage, event/season, online/offline state, controller/touch input, IAP/currency state, and whether launch-era Asphalt 9 behavior is unrecoverable.

secondary.exclusive_content: Historical balance/economy and platform rollout state
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if a preserved old build is being documented.
secondary.why: The normal current route is Asphalt Legends Unite.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Asphalt 9 live-service route, now evolved through updates.
Current rebranded live client with expanded platform/cross-play state.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live-service economy, seasons, cars, and launch-era states cannot be fully reconstructed later.

entries.remaster_caveats: Formerly Asphalt 9: Legends; do not merge with Asphalt 8: Airborne.
